patches.what: A where clause on a unit struct (`struct X where T: Eq;`)
The `~` token inside macro token trees
`<=` after a cast to a named type (`x as size_t <= y`)

patches.author: Pymtheg W2-V (not upstream)
patches.what: `raw` is not a keyword: the raw-borrow marker is an identifier aliased to the anonymous node `raw`, only directly after `&` and before `const`/`mut`; `raw` is removed from `_reserved_identifier`. Fixes the v0.24.x regression where `raw` as a type name, generic parameter, item name or `raw @ pattern` failed the file; `&raw` on a variable stays a plain borrow and `&raw const`/`&raw mut` trees are unchanged

patches.author: Pymtheg W2-V (not upstream)
patches.what: The edition-2024 `safe` qualifier (`safe fn` / `safe static` in `unsafe extern` blocks) as an identifier aliased to the anonymous node `safe`, only at the start of a body-less function signature or a static item; `safe` stays an ordinary identifier elsewhere (unlike upstream PR #256, which reserves it)

patches.author: Pymtheg C-21 (not upstream)
patches.what: A macro named like a primitive type (`str![...]`, `u8!(...)`; macros have their own namespace), and a primitive type name with generic arguments as a type path (`&str<u8, el>`, valid syntax in proc-macro input)

patches.author: Pymtheg C-21 (not upstream)
patches.what: A lifetime first in a trait object's bounds (`dyn 'a + Display`, `dyn 'static + for<'a> FnMut(..)`), read as `dynamic_type(trait: bounded_type(lifetime, ..))` like upstream #258 does for `impl`; `dyn T + 'a` keeps its old tree

patches.author: Pymtheg C-21 (not upstream)
patches.what: Any number of outer attributes on a function parameter (`#[rustfmt::skip] #[cfg(..)] x: T`), and outer attributes on closure parameters (`|#[allow(unused)] x| ..`)

patches.author: Pymtheg C-21 (not upstream)
patches.what: Nightly `box` patterns (`box_patterns` feature: `Err(box E::A { .. })`) as a `box_pattern` node holding the inner pattern

patches.author: Pymtheg C-21 (not upstream)
patches.what: A trait object on the left of a where predicate (`where dyn Trait: Bound`)

patches.author: Pymtheg C-21 (not upstream)
patches.what: A turbofish in a struct pattern's path (`let S::<T> { .. } = ..`), as tuple-struct patterns already allow; the grammar part of upstream PR #301 (not taken whole: its attribute change overlaps PR #319)
